# Elizabeth Stein

> Full-stack developer and designer shipping production code across three orgs. Capella B.S., Summa Cum Laude (3.98 GPA, conferred March 2026). Sole developer on a cybersecurity nonprofit's Dynamics 365 / Power Platform assessment, live in production. Algolia Agent Studio Challenge winner, npm publisher, and MCP server author.

## About
elizabethannstein.com is the portfolio of Elizabeth Stein, a full-stack engineer specializing in Microsoft Power Platform (Dynamics 365, Dataverse), Next.js, React, TypeScript, and AI integration (Claude, MCP servers, RAG). The site presents her work as an editorial index of 86 shipped projects, with a recruiter fast-track to the strongest, verifiable proof, plus an optional interactive 3D WebGPU "galaxy" view at /explore.

## Proof
- Security readiness platform (cybersecurity nonprofit, client confidential): sole developer on a production Dynamics 365 / Power Platform assessment, front-end externalized to a Next.js app.
- TimeSlipSearch: Algolia Agent Studio Challenge winner ($750), search over 420k records.
- Specter: published npm package (@purplegumdropz/specter), 65 CLI commands, 14 MCP tools.
- Trace: DEV.to GitHub Finish-Up-A-Thon winner. Turns a screenshot into a runnable React component using Google Gemini grounded in a shadcn catalog.
- HireReady: Live SaaS with OpenAI Realtime voice AI interview practice and FSRS-5 spaced repetition.
- Chronicle: Local-first AI agent observability platform in Rust (Axum + SQLite) with semantic caching.
